description: This file contains Dutch ('nl') localization strings for the Select2 JavaScript plugin, specifically version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translated messages for various user interface prompts and errors within the plugin.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to delete excess characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message prompting user to enter more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message when no search results are found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating that a search is in progress.
